$comment: Phase 9 budgets of RUST_MIGRATION.md. Every entry names what is measured, in which unit and where. scripts/check-budgets.mjs enforces them.

ui_bundle.context: Desktop frontend (crates/app/ui) after `npm run build`: the UI bundle of the Phase 9 table.
ui_bundle.note: 1.5 MB raw and 400 KB gzip, the limits from RUST_MIGRATION.md section 1.

web_bundle.context: Browser build (crates/web/dist) after `trunk build --release`; a separate target, documented in RUST_MIGRATION.md section 14.
web_bundle.note: Regression guard for the browser target. The 1.5 MB / 400 KB Phase 9 budget is not applied here: the browser host ships egui and SQLite as WebAssembly, which section 14 records explicitly.

cold_start.context: Release binary `target/release/socdof-app --database <fresh temp file>`; wall time from spawn to exit with the line `SOCDOF shell ready` (instance lock, schema migration, status read).
cold_start.note: The windowed desktop adds only the Tauri window creation on top of this path; CI measures that in the gui-smoke job.

installer.context: Native Rust desktop executable `target/release/socdof-ui-desktop`; Tauri remains a migration fallback and is reported separately.
installer.note: Only measurable where GTK/WebKit and the Tauri toolchain exist (CI desktop job). The script reports `not built here` instead of guessing.

installed.context: Current native portable distribution footprint (single executable); platform installer payloads will receive a separate measurement when native installers are added.

idle_ram.context: Resident memory of the native Rust `socdof-ui-desktop` process sampled from /proc/<pid>/status (VmRSS) after five seconds without input.
idle_ram.note: Requires a display; measured in the CI gui-smoke job under Xvfb.

idle_cpu.context: CPU time of the native Rust `socdof-ui-desktop` process from /proc/<pid>/stat over a five second quiet interval.
idle_cpu.note: Requires a display; measured in the CI gui-smoke job under Xvfb.

large_dataset.context: Contacts and invoices screens with 50k contacts and 100k invoices, rendered by the real egui layout in crates/ui/tests/performance.rs.
